Q1.rationale: Segments 17-18 set the obligations to expire at the earlier of sixty months after signing or completion of the Sale, so obligations run beyond the agreement's signing date, though the NDA never addresses termination or survival in those words, so this is a borderline match.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: Segment 2 bars disclosure of any Confidential Information to any other person without the Sellers' prior written consent, with no whistleblower or violation-reporting carve-out; the only regulator-related provision, segment 21, covers legally compelled disclosure with prior notice, not voluntary reports.
Q2.label: Entailment
